name: liamklyneker
description: Liam Klyneker's personal Claude Code skills, packaged as installable plugins

plugins.name: prd-workflow
plugins.description: PRD-to-merge workflow for Claude Code: turn context into a PRD, slice it into tracer-bullet issues and run the whole thing end-to-end with a per-issue worker subagent, or file and implement one self-contained task, and triage the QA findings that come back into cold-runnable issues. Start with /prd-workflow:setup, which writes the project adapter every skill here reads

plugins.name: figma-tools
plugins.description: Design-to-brief tools for Claude Code, from two design sources: Figma nodes and a designer-authored code prototype. Turns either into a per-ticket design brief whose fidelity ledger the grill resolves, against a per-project design-system catalog its ds-catalog skill generates and annotates, or in a library repo against the library's own source. In a library repo it also turns a design brief into a proposed component the user steers in a UI component lab, which its create-ui-component-lab skill installs

plugins.name: ado-workflow
plugins.description: The PRD-to-merge workflow brought to Azure DevOps for Claude Code: publish a spec, slice it into tasks, pick the next one, and run the whole thing end-to-end with a per-task worker subagent. Start with /ado-workflow:setup, which writes the project adapter every skill here reads

plugins.name: lk
plugins.description: Liam Klyneker's personal Claude Code skills: the grills that interview a plan until every branch is resolved, plus pinpoint, scoped-context, his writing voice, report, which files a session's conclusion about a skill as a sanitized issue on the skills repo, and human-review, which walks a reviewer through one pull request and posts the one review they approve

plugins.name: qa
plugins.description: The automated QA pass for Claude Code and the two files it starts from: build-knowledge derives a page's KNOWLEDGE.md from its code, setup-states observes the staging org and records the page states it holds in the project's accounts.md, and prove-branch resolves the run from the checked-out branch, composes flows from the diff, the acceptance criteria of the highest product source the branch reaches and those two files, drives them in a real browser against the pull request's preview deployment, grades the evidence in a cold-context session, and posts one receipt to the ticket, or to the pull request when the branch names none
